comment: UPS direct-checkout allowlist for the fixed 2.0.4 repair. Every entry is an exact published variation with nonzero live WooCommerce weight/dimensions and a researched one-piece package estimate below published generic UPS maxima. These are NOT physical measurements and NOT carrier approval. Freight-class, oversized, incomplete, unknown, mismatched, malformed and expired entries remain fail-closed. This file becomes live only through a separately staged and approved plugin plan.
